title: Stay Dry
text: Stay Dry. Perfect color. Confusing order - was expecting sets of bath towels. Maybe my oversight but remember looking 3/3 times for size unable to locate so assumed:(

product_metadata.title: Weidemans Premium Towel Set of 8 Hand Towels 18" x 30" Color: Plum | Pure Cotton |Machine Washable High Absorbency
features: 🛁 SOFT AND FLUFFY: These bathroom hand towels are made from an extremely soft cotton which is ultra soft on the skin, making it desirable even for users with a sensitive skin. Even though they feel soft and thick, they are extremely light.

💦 ABSORBENT AND DURABLE: The texture of the bathroom towel is delicate, and the composition and the density of the towel makes it highly absorbent to liquids and also extremely durable. They have previously been combed to remove the longest fibers in order to bring its luxurious feel.

🧼 MACHINE WASHABLE AND DRYER SAFE: The hand towels can be washed in the machine and also dried later on without any possible consequences. It is super easy to wash and maintain. They require only a simple machine wash, so you can wash them just like every other towel.
Machine washable and dryable. For best use, wash separately on first use.

🌿 ECO FRIENDLY HAND TOWELS: Made from all natural materials. We avoid dangerous chemicals and softeners in the manufacturing process, and we use eco-friendly materials in order to contribute to saving our planet.
description: Weidemans presenting "Urban Towel Collection" of 4 Pcs Towel Set 100% Cotton in modern Colors. Towel Set of 4 Pieces exclusive Hand Towels 18" x 30" These Soft and high absorbant Towels are suitable for daily usage and are OekoTex Standard 100 Certified The STANDARD 100 by OEKO-TEX is a worldwide consistent, independent testing and certification system for raw, semi-finished, and finished textile products at all processing levels, as well as accessory materials used Washing Instructions: Machine wash warmWash color separately before useTumble dry lowOnly non-chlorine bleach when neededUse mild detergent
